title: Analysis code for: Amygdala subregion atrophy in Parkinson's disease is associated with visual hallucinations and cognitive impairment
description: Python analysis code reproducing the statistical results, tables and figures of the manuscript, using harmonised FreeSurfer amygdala nucleus volumes and clinical data from the Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative (PPMI, RRID:SCR_006431). No participant data are included. This research was funded in whole or in part by Aligning Science Across Parkinson's (ASAP-027449) through the Michael J. Fox Foundation for Parkinson's Research (MJFF). For the purpose of open access, the authors have applied a CC BY 4.0 public copyright license to all Author Accepted Manuscripts arising from this submission.
